## Pick a data source

Run one of these two lines before sourcing the setup, depending on what you
want to do. The default is `legacy`.

```{r mode_toggle, eval=FALSE}
options(aquafaang.mode = "legacy")     # reproduce the published figures
options(aquafaang.mode = "salmobase")  # replicate from raw RNA-seq via Salmobase
options(aquafaang.test = TRUE)         # shortcut slow chunks for testing
```

## Run setup

Everything that the downstream notebooks need (`paths`, helpers, constants,
the package stack) lives in `R/setup.R`. Source it once per session.

```{r run_setup}
source("R/setup.R")
sessionInfo()
```

## Configuration in scope

```{r show_config}
cat("DATA_MODE = ", DATA_MODE, "\n", sep = "")
cat("TEST_MODE = ", TEST_MODE, "\n", sep = "")
cat("N_PERMUTATIONS = ", N_PERMUTATIONS, "\n", sep = "")
str(paths$active, max.level = 1)
```
